subject: Post-call: Nova pilot — econ buyer mapping & SOC 2 evidence sprint
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Sylvia Kim <sylvia.kim@novasolutions.com>, Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@novasolutions.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2029-11-04T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: Nova pilot — econ buyer mapping & SOC 2 evidence sprint

Hi Sylvia / Tom,

Thanks again for the time this morning — good conversation and helpful context on the pilot goals. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all have alignment: 

1) Decision criteria (what we heard):
   - 1) Cost-per-100k-requests (budget target: <$350)
   - 2) End-to-end latency for inference (p95 target: <400ms)
   - 3) Data residency & audit logs (must satisfy internal compliance)

2) Stakeholder map (confirmed today):
   - Economic buyer: Tom Hsu (VP Product) — will own budget sign-off
   - Security/compliance: Sylvia Kim (Head of Infosec) — will validate SOC 2 + pen test posture
   - Procurement: procurement@novasolutions.com — will handle T&C and PO
   - Engineering champion: David Lopez (we met briefly) — run pilot tests

3) Evidence & timeline proposal:
   - Redwood will deliver: SOC 2 summary + mapping doc, latest pen-test report summary, audit-logs retention options, and a short runbook for data segregation.
   - Target delivery: SOC 2 summary + evidence matrix by 2029-11-06 EOD (two business days) — see attached REDWOOD-SOC2-SUMMARY.pdf (summary + scope).

4) Pilot plan ask:
   - Start: sandbox deployment next week
   - Success criteria: throughput test (tps) and latency under 400ms at sample traffic, and no security red flags from your security review.

Next steps we propose:
   - Rafael/Marissa: deliver evidence package by 11/06.
   - Sylvia: confirm whether pen-test report level of detail is sufficient or if you need raw findings.
   - Tom: confirm budget owner approval timeline (target decision by 11/20).

Attaching: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf and a starter stake map (pilot-econbuyer-stake-map.xlsx) — we can update after any changes you share.

If that aligns, we’ll open a mutual action plan in HubSpot and tee up a kickoff for the week of 11/11.

Thanks,
Rafael
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
r.mendes@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (pdf), pilot-econbuyer-stake-map.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Sylvia Kim <sylvia.kim@novasolutions.com>

Cc: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@novasolutions.com>, Procurement <procurement@novasolutions.com>
Date: 2029-11-04T13:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Nova pilot — econ buyer mapping & SOC 2 evidence sprint

Rafael — thanks for the clear recap. A couple of clarifications from our side: 

- SOC 2 summary: yes please include the scope (systems in scope), issuer, and date of last audit. A one-page control mapping (where Redwood controls map to our control numbers) would be ideal.
- Pen test: summary is fine for initial review; we will escalate to our third-party if anything looks borderline. We may request the full report under an NDA if we go to pilot.
- Audit logs: we need retention options (30/90/365 days) and an outline of which events are captured (auth, model calls, file access).

Procurement: can you confirm the standard PO flow and whether a redline will be needed?

We expect to start technical review next week. If Rafael/Marissa can deliver the package by 11/06 that will give us time to loop in Product Security prior to our meeting on 11/12.

– Sylvia
Head of Information Security | Nova Solutions
Sylvia.Kim@novasolutions.com

We reviewed the SOC 2 summary and the pen-test stub; a couple of minor asks before we sign off for pilot: 

- Please provide a one-paragraph explanation for each high/critical finding remediation status (we can accept the redacted stub).
- Confirm the audit-log export will include request-id, timestamp (UTC), user-id, model-id, and response-code; 90-day retention is preferred but confirm retention/archival pricing.
- Procurement: please share the vendor questionnaire link and any required PO templates.

If you can get the remediation paragraph and log schema by tomorrow (11/07), we can greenlight a sandbox kickoff and schedule Product Security for a 11/12 deep dive. Tom — we’ll aim to resolve budget questions in the week of 11/18.

Appreciate the responsiveness — Sylvia
